7 Discussion
We have presented a new class of high order model
where exact inference can be done very eﬃcientlyR This
model can be used on its ownO and it is already able to
capture a mix of high and low order statistics that
would be diﬃcult for other tractable modelsR The
model can also be used as a subcomponent within
outer approximate inference proceduresO allowing efP
ﬁcient approximate marginal inference for hard probP
lems that few other approaches are able to tackleR
The general approach—of adding a set of auxiliary
variables with highly structured interactions so as to
guarantee eﬃcient message passing inference—leads to
eﬃcient exact inference in other extended models such
as tree structured models augmented with a cardinalP
ity potentialO and we believe the approach to extend
even beyond thatR
oinallyO we have presented a diverse set of applications
and shown how many problems that are not naturally
thought of in terms of cardinality potentials can be
cast as suchR We believe that the highly eﬃcient algoP
rithms discussed here will only increase the number of
applications where cardinality potentials are usefulR
